messages:
Sam: quick question — if a request comes in with both `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `X-API-Key: <key>`, which one should server prefer? also how should project vs org scoping interact when both are present? planning a small contract tweak for v2 auth behavior.

Anya: go with specificity precedence: prefer a project-scoped credential over an org-scoped one. so if X-API-Key is project-scoped and valid -> use that. if X-API-Key is invalid but bearer is a valid org token, allow but log and tag telemetry.

Devin: +1 on specificity. for implementation, validate both but short-circuit on the more specific valid credential. pseudocode: 
```
// auth middleware
if (xApiKey) {
  k = validateKey(xApiKey)
  if (k.valid && k.scope === 'project') return OK(projectIdentity)
  if (k.valid && k.scope === 'org' && request.targetInOrg) return OK(orgIdentity)
  // if invalid, continue to try bearer
}
if (bearer) {
  t = validateBearer(bearer)
  if (t.valid) return OK(t.identity)
}
return 401 // no valid credentials
```

Devin: also: invalid creds -> 401. valid creds but insufficient permissions -> 403. keep messages small and machine-friendly: error_code + hint.

Maria: rotation note: accept old+new keys during a configurable grace window (default 24h). mark deprecated keys in metadata and emit `auth.rotation=grace` in logs. when fallback to org-token happens, add a non-sensitive header `X-Auth-Fallback: org` for observability (no internal details).

Sam: for client UX, let's standardize error payload: `{"error":"unauthorized","reason":"invalid_api_key","hint":"rotate key at /console/keys"}`. also include `WWW-Authenticate` for oauth flows. avoid leaking whether a key exists.

Anya: agree. also add an `X-Auth-Warning` response header when we allowed auth via fallback to org token (useful for SDKs to surface deprecation warnings). keep it terse, e.g. `X-Auth-Warning: fallback-to-org` or `X-Auth-Warning: old-key-accepted`.

Devin: I'll add unit tests + integration vectors: valid project key, expired project + valid org, invalid both, valid org but insufficient scope -> assert 403. will also add a feature flag `auth.precedence=by_specificity` so we can flip if needed. pinging @Maria for rollout window.

Maria: SGTM. aim to roll to prod Tue 21:00 UTC after a staging soak. I'll add an internal RFC PR summarizing precedence, rotation grace, headers to emit, and test matrix. please include sample cURL snippets in the PR.

Sam: small nits: ensure logs redact full keys but include key_id and `auth.method` tag. add a debug-only endpoint to replay auth failures for infra.

deploy-bot: deploy-staging: build #432 succeeded :white_check_mark: (tests pass).

Devin: copying the minimal cURL examples i'll add to the PR:
```
# project key preferred
curl -H "X-API-Key: pk_live_123" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/models

# bearer fallback
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_org_abc" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/models
```

Sam: thanks — i'll wait for the PR and then do a quick review. :eyes:
